title: 나의 생활 습관: 날마다, 주말마다 뭐 해요?
objective: By the end, you can attach 마다 to a noun to talk about your routines (아침마다, 주말마다, 두 시간마다) and to say "each one" (나라마다), and you can choose correctly between 매일 and 날마다.
summary: Learn the particle 마다 to say that something happens every time, or that each person or place is different.

task.title: Use 마다 correctly
task.line: Read each item, then choose, fill in, rewrite, fix, or answer in Korean using what you learned about 마다.

forms.when: After time words: 아침, 저녁, 밤, 주말, 월요일, 날 …
forms.means: every (morning, weekend …); it happens again and again

forms.when: When you talk about time, both are possible: 매일 = 날마다, 매년 = 해마다, 매주 토요일 = 토요일마다
forms.means: same meaning: every day / every year / every Saturday
forms.exampleMeaning: My younger brother plays soccer every weekend.

forms.when: After a number with a unit: 10분, 두 시간, 3일 …
forms.exampleMeaning: I drink water once every hour.

forms.when: After 사람, 나라, 집, 가게, 학교 …, often with 달라요 or 있어요
forms.means: each (person, country …); every one of them
forms.exampleMeaning: Each country has a different way of greeting.

watchOut: 매일마다 (X) → 매일 (O): 매 and 마다 both mean 'every', so use only one. Say 매일 or 날마다.
주말 마다 (X) → 주말마다 (O): 마다 is a particle, so write it right after the noun with no space.
일요일마다에 (X) → 일요일마다 (O): do not put 에 after 마다. 마다 already tells you when.
매 사람 (X) → 사람마다 (O): for people and places, use noun + 마다, not 매.
exercises: Choose the correct word: ① 저는 (매일 / 매일마다) 한국어를 공부해요. ② 우리 회사는 (금요일마다 / 금요일마다에) 회의를 해요.
Fill in the blank: 이 약은 여섯 시간____ 먹어야 해요.
Rewrite the sentence with 마다 (keep the same meaning): 매주 토요일에 등산을 가요.
Choose the right meaning of this sentence: 식당마다 김치 맛이 달라요. (a) Every restaurant's kimchi tastes the same. (b) The kimchi tastes different at each restaurant.
Each sentence has one mistake. Rewrite the wrong word correctly: ① 저는 저녁 마다 산책해요. ② 저는 밤마다에 일기를 써요.
Read the timetable and answer in Korean: 「셔틀버스 출발 시간: 9:00, 9:20, 9:40, 10:00, 10:20」 셔틀버스는 몇 분마다 와요?
answers: (b) The kimchi tastes different at each restaurant.
